editorial:
Imagine you're stuck in a tiny submersible miles below the ocean when a massive prehistoric shark shows up. That's the wild ride you get here. Jason Statham plays Jonas Taylor, a rescue diver who once lost a crew to something huge in the deep. Years later, he's pulled back into action when a research team gets trapped in the Mariana Trench. The vibe is pure summer blockbuster fun, mixing big scares with goofy humor. You'll feel the tension of the deep sea while laughing at the over-the-top action. It leans into its silly premise and delivers exactly what you want from a giant shark movie.

The action scenes are the real highlight. Statham brings his usual tough guy charm, and the shark looks impressive on screen. The pacing keeps things moving fast, though some side characters feel flat. The humor lands more often than not. If you love creature features and don't mind a movie that doesn't take itself too seriously, you'll have a blast. It's perfect for a weekend movie night with friends. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The Meg is finally lured into shallow water where it can be killed. Jonas and his team use a dead whale as bait to draw the shark close. After a fierce battle, Jonas stabs the Meg with a poison-tipped spear, and the shark is torn apart by smaller sharks. The team survives, and Jonas reunites with his love interest. The final scene shows a wedding celebration, hinting at a happy ending for everyone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves giant monster movies and doesn't mind a little cheese
